fields.name: year
fields.description: Solar year, 1900 to 2100. Defaults to the solar year in progress, which changes at Li Chun rather than on 1 January.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Solar month, 1 to 12, where 1 begins at Li Chun in early February. This is NOT the calendar month: solar month 1 covers roughly 4 February to 5 March. Defaults to the solar month in progress.
